text:
maria-finance: Hey team — need quick deal-desk approval for SmartBilling (enterprise). They disputed the Feb invoice and are threatening to pause. Proposal: one-time credit of $45,200 + 3 months of 20% usage discount. Requesting @elena-cfo approval by EOD. Context & links below.

ravi-sales: +1 from sales. They're a strategic customer, renewing in Q3. We committed a short onboarding credit in email thread (see link). Losing them costs more than this credit.

nate-salesops: Pulled the numbers — usage spike matches their integration test window. Raw: 1,280,000 tokens billed vs committed 1,000,000. Overage math in sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/smartbilling-usage (view-only). Reconciliation suggests $48,600 gross overage; proposed $45,200 credit is cost-shared.

billing-bot: Invoice generated: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-02-18
Billed amount: $62,800
Usage lines: COMM-1M: $30,000; OVR-280K: $32,800
``` 

maria-finance: Key points: 1) Sales promised onboarding credit (approx $20k) but wasn't applied on billing system. 2) Customer ran large smoke tests without dev key flagging — operational. 3) We're proposing to apply one-time credit to bring the invoice to $17,600 and then a 3-month 20% discount to ease churn risk.

elena-cfo: Need quick legal sign-off + confirmation we don't set a pricing precedent. @tom-legal weigh in on special terms and any exec escalation.

tom-legal: I reviewed contract SOW v2. No explicit clause forbidding one-off credits. Recommend adding a short amendment: "one-time reconciliation credit" + non-precedent language. I'll draft the amendment; need customer acceptance.

ravi-sales: If legal drafts amendment we can get customer to sign this morning. They already offered to sign a short addendum to close the renewal conversation.

nate-salesops: Updated sheet with final numbers and journal entry suggestion. GL account: Customer Credits (4102), memo: SmartBilling-Feb reconciliation. Jose in AR will post once approved.

maria-finance: Approval ask: CFO sign-off on $45,200 one-time credit AND finance leader ok on 3mo 20% discount (applies to next invoices). Also need legal to approve amendment text. Can we do approvals thread visible here? 

elena-cfo: Approved for the $45,200 credit and the 3-month 20% discount. Please include the non-precedent clause Tom mentioned. @maria-finance, add to finance queue and cc AR.

tom-legal: Drafted amendment and uploaded: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/smartbilling-credit-v1. I added: "This one-time credit is a reconciliatory adjustment and shall not constitute a change to Redwood's standard pricing or create precedent for other accounts." Customer has reviewed; awaiting signed DocuSign.

billing-bot: DocuSign request sent to customer (SmartBilling). Envelope ID: DSGN-789234. Status: sent.

maria-finance: Thanks all — posting final entries after signed doc. FYI tagging AR: @jose-ar will post a memo and close the invoice. 

nate-salesops: I'll update CRM with concession code: DEALDESK-ONEOFF-2026 and flag renewal team. 

ravi-sales: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please route any follow-ups to me and I'll own the customer comms. :thumbsup:

elena-cfo: Good work. Keep an eye on any similar spikes, but approved as an exception. :white_check_mark:
